shared_elements: relief figures arranged in horizontal registers
a row of repeated similar figures along an upper band
a small disc/round element within a scene
a horizontal band separating upper from lower zones
justification: Both surfaces divide an upright slab into stacked horizontal registers, with a row of repeated similar figures across an upper band and further figural content below, and both include creatures rendered in strict profile plus a small disc element. But the content is fundamentally different: A shows isolated wild animals (quadruped heads, a predator, birds, a snake-like form) with a zigzag band and no writing, while B shows an anthropomorphic divine assembly of standing human-bodied figures facing one another beneath a winged disc, above many lines of script — none of A's motifs recur in B, and vice versa.
